title: BlueBlocks: HIPAA-Compliant P2P Protocol Implementation
description:
Design and implement secure P2P protocol for HIPAA-compliant healthcare data transfer.

## Protocol Features
- Zero-knowledge transport (relay nodes cannot decrypt PHI)
- End-to-end encryption (X25519 key exchange, AES-256-GCM)
- Onion-style routing through relay network
- Chunked file transfer for large medical images/video
- Immutable audit logging on-chain

## Cryptographic Stack
- Key Exchange: X25519 (Curve25519 ECDH)
- Symmetric Encryption: AES-256-GCM
- Signing: Ed25519
- Key Derivation: Argon2id
- Hashing: BLAKE3

## HIPAA Technical Safeguards
- Access Control (§164.312(a)(1)) - Patient-controlled keys, smart contract ACL
- Audit Controls (§164.312(b)) - Immutable on-chain audit log
- Integrity (§164.312(c)(1)) - BLAKE3 hashing, Ed25519 signatures
- Transmission Security (§164.312(e)(1)) - TLS 1.3 + E2E encryption
- Encryption (§164.312(a)(2)(iv)) - AES-256-GCM at rest and in transit
